name: Fujiwara no Atsutada
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 43); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 943.

poems.title: How desolate my former life
poems.author: Fujiwara no Atsutada
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 43
poems.text:
How desolate my former life,
Those dismal years, ere yet
I chanced to see thee face to face;
’Twere better to forget
Those days before we met.

poems.title: 43. 逢ひみての 後の心に くらぶれば (Aimite no nochi no kokoro ni kurabureba)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Atsutada
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 拾遺集
poems.text:
逢ひみての 後の心に くらぶれば
昔はものを 思はざりけり
